description: This file contains unit tests for a hashmap implementation, including tests for insertion, retrieval, removal, iteration, and case sensitivity handling of hashmap entries.

methods.name: void test_hashmap__intern(void)
methods.description: Tests that string interning provides the same pointer for identical strings and different pointers for different strings.

methods.description: Tests the replacement behavior in the hashmap with case-sensitive keys.
